2607.02370.title: Understanding Agent-Based Patching of Compiler Missed Optimizations
2607.02370.paper_summary: Compiler missed optimizations refer to cases in which compilers failed to optimize certain code. It takes many compiler developers' efforts to implement or patch such missed optimizations. In this paper, we present a systematic study of how well agents patch compiler missed optimizations. We identify a significant challenge that patching a missed optimization requires more than just fixing the reported case, and instead requires generalizing to similar cases. We construct a benchmark of real-world LLVM missed optimization issues and compare agent-generated patches with patches from developers in terms of optimization scope. Our results show that coding agents often optimize the given examples, but many generated patches either cover only part of the developer-intended scope or partially overlap with it; in some cases, they further generalize beyond the reference patch. We further introduce historical-knowledge augmentation techniques that leverage prior LLVM optimization pull requests through retrieval and distillation, showing that they improve developer-aligned generalization and yield practical benefits when applied to real-world IR.
2607.02370.paper_summary_zh: 編譯器錯過的優化是指編譯器未能優化某些代碼的情況。實現或修補這些錯過的優化需要許多編譯器開發者的努力。在本文中，我們系統性地研究了代理如何修補編譯器錯過的優化。我們確定了一個重大挑戰，即修補錯過的優化不僅僅需要修復報告的案例，而是需要將其推廣到類似的案例。我們構建了一個現實世界中 LLVM 錯過的優化問題的基準，並在優化範圍方面比較了代理生成的修補與開發者的修補。我們的結果顯示，編碼代理通常會優化給定的示例，但許多生成的修補僅涵蓋開發者預期範圍的一部分或與其部分重疊；在某些情況下，它們進一步推廣超過參考修補。我們還介紹了歷史知識增強技術，這些技術通過檢索和提煉利用先前的 LLVM 優化拉取請求，顯示它們改善了與開發者對齊的推廣，並在應用於現實世界的 IR 時產生實際效益。
